briefdescription.para: Checks whether given address range (addr + size) is contained within specified Memory Region or going beyond (for potential overlap)

parameterdescription.para: Start Address of the Region to compare
End Address of the Region to compare
Start Address of the Memory Range
End Address of the Memory Range

simplesect.para: ADDR_IN_RANGE if the address range is within the region, ADDR_RANGE_OVERLAP if overlapping region (or ADDR_NOT_IN_RANGE otherwise)
The assumption is that input address region is valid only if it starts within a valid memory region.

inbodydescription.para: Input: |==============| RegionStart RegionEnd Memory: |-----------------| StartAddr EndAddr
Input: |============================| RegionStart RegionEnd Memory: |--------------------| StartAddr EndAddr

briefdescription.para: Checks whether a given address range is not in any of the exclusion regions.

simplesect.para: ==XPM_FAILURE (if range in exclusion list), ==XPM_SUCCESS (if range not in exclusion list)

inbodydescription.para: extract RTCA Image Store Address Range 32-bit higher store address: 0xF2014288 32-bit lower store address: 0xf201428C 32-bit size: 0xF2014290
